method: static read of the prior investigators' consolidated registers, matrices, ledgers and tooling records; no re-derivation of target evidence

scope.note: Includes 74 Python tooling scripts, 17 batch manifests, 55 registers/matrices and synthesis catalogues.

findings.title: A consolidated findings register of 41 items exists (9 High, 16 Medium, 11 Low, 5 Info)
findings.detail: unified-findings-register.csv consolidates findings from origins B1|B2|B3|B4|FIN. High-severity (9): U-001 default admin/admin operator credentials documented in the manual; U-002 patient-DB backup via generated .bat/.sql; U-003 hardcoded remote patient-DB credential in the .NET e-mail component; U-004 installer creates SQL Server 'sa' with a hardcoded password; U-005 bulk-deletion maintenance tools over every clinical table; U-006 installer scripts execute unverified payloads by absolute path and attach DB from hardcoded D:\Lab_data; U-016 SMS gateway over plain HTTP with credentials in URL; U-018 41 of 62 PE binaries unsigned; U-037 SQL 'sa' password assembled at runtime from fragments and shipped cleartext.

findings.title: The main executable is VB6 compiled to NATIVE code (resolves the Type 1 p-code/native question)
findings.detail: findings_register.csv F-01 records NATIVE code, verified by six independent evidence lines: VB5! magic at the entry-pushed address; push+call[ThunRTMain] stub; 186 MSVBVM60 imports (118 __vba*); a 40,076,128-byte native code span in ProjectInfo; Ghidra x86:LE:32:default:windows with MSVBVM60 linkage; REA inspect_pe_imports coverage=complete. This upgrades Type 1 FIND-T1-001 (which left p-code/native unresolved) to a resolved fact.

findings.title: Procedure/method names are absent from the executable by design (VB6 native, names never stored)
findings.detail: findings_register.csv F-07: procedure names absent, confirmed by two independent methods (static ObjectInfo lpMethodNames=null for all modules; dynamic Ghidra category_named=0). This explains why Type 1 could recover object names and method counts but not method names.

findings.title: Object/form counts differ between the two builds (169/163 for V-ROOT-1.00 vs 212/198 for v1.605)
findings.detail: B1's findings_register F-02 records 163 forms + 5 modules + 1 class = 169 VB6 objects for the V-ROOT-1.00 executable (118 forms + 45 report forms = 163). Type 1 vb6-objects.json records 212 objects / 8,026 methods / 132 forms + 66 DataReports for the v1.605 executable. The most plausible explanation is a version difference between the two builds (V1.00 vs v1.605), not a tool error. Recorded as CON-002 and flagged provisional pending a direct comparison of both object tables.

findings.title: Unresolved-question register: 17 questions, 5 still UNRESOLVED
findings.detail: unified-unresolved-questions.csv: 1 RESOLVED (UNR-001: authoritative exe = sha c54ce6c8…), 5 UNRESOLVED, 4 NO, 4 PARTIALLY RESOLVED, 2 NO-ANSWERED, 1 ANSWERED. Key open items: UNR-002 meaning of 17 grantN operator-permission columns; UNR-003 seven IDPassword* values; UNR-004 two 32-char uppercase literals (possible obfuscated credentials); UNR-005 whether accuntpw is hashed (evidence suggests cleartext); UNR-008 mapping of ~1,370 embedded SELECTs to backends.

findings.title: Prior methodology and tool limitations are documented (13 tools)
findings.detail: tool_usage_matrix.csv records REA (PE corroborator only; no VB6 p-code/Jet/CAB/CHM support), Ghidra 12.1.4 (function census; no pseudocode for the 59 MB exe), mdbtools 1.0.0 (schema only; mdb-export never invoked; no rows), 7-Zip (CHM/CAB), cabextract 1.9 (list/extract), python3 custom parsers (PE/VB6/CHM/CAB), file(1), sha256sum, openssl 3.x, olefile, strings/grep/diff, pdfplumber/pypdf, dotnet 9.0.316. This is essential QA context for confidence scoring.

findings.title: Coverage record: B1/B2/B3 per-category coverage with an explicit schema-only MDB policy
findings.detail: coverage.json (B3) and coverage_matrix.csv (batches 1,2,3; 16 category rows) record file-level coverage. The .mdb categories are marked 'mdb-tables + mdb-schema (SCHEMA ONLY, no rows)': row data was never read, by policy. Some categories are partial (e.g. .cat catalogue via text/hex only).

findings.title: Cross-version matrix: 837 file relationships between V-ROOT-1.00 and V-CD-2019
findings.detail: cross-version-matrix.csv (837 rows; version_id V-ROOT-1.00 364, V-CD-2019 473): cross_class RELOCATED_IDENTICAL 41, REL_IDENTICAL 127, REL_DIFFERENT 190, NO_PARTNER_IN_OTHER_VERSION 479. 190 files differ between the two versions; 168 are byte-identical (41 relocated + 127 same-path). This quantifies what changed between V1.00 and V-CD-2019.

findings.title: Master file ledger covers 837 files across 9 component tags
findings.detail: ledger.csv (837 rows) maps every target file to an inventory_id, version_id, component_tag, hash and analysis state. Component tags: V1-INSTALLED-APP 364, V2-DEPLOY-PAYLOAD 361, V2-REDIST-VB6RUNTIME 73, V2-SYSTEM-STAGING 13, V2-CD-TOOLS 12, V2-REDIST-PDF 7, V2-INSTALLMEDIA-WIN7/WINXP 3 each, V2-REDIST-MDAC 1. (Note: this ledger's integrity column reads NOT_YET_RECEIVED for all 837 rows — it is a forward plan from a different workspace state, not a record of this batch's files.)

findings.title: Evidence-gap register: specific missing artefacts that would close open questions
findings.detail: upload_priority_matrix.csv lists missing evidence: RL_CD2019Access/System/real lab system.exe (would settle single-vs-multiple builds), bin/calculator.exe and bin/real lab timer.exe (sibling apps referenced by path), real lab Image Gallery.exe (pictures consumer), vkUserControlsXP.ocx, Avira (avipbb.sys + engine DLLs/.dat), ark.ico, Patients_backup.mdb, D:\Lab_data\Attaching.sql + Attach_database.bat, and the 3 VS6sp6B*.cab member contents.

findings.title: Evidence of a possible THIRD database backend (MySQL)
findings.detail: upload_priority_matrix.csv references 'mysql-connector-odbc-3.51.30-win32.msi' and speaks of 'confirming the third (MySQL) back end at package level'. Combined with SQL Server (Type 1) and Access/Jet (Type 2), this hints at a third backend. It is recorded as a hypothesis (Class 3) because the MySQL connector was not itself present in this batch.

findings.title: Runtime behaviour: schema-migration engine runs DDL at start-up; IE COM automation for HTTP
findings.detail: FND-F-004 (traceability-matrix.csv): the executable carries its own schema-migration engine and runs DDL (CREATE TABLE etc.) against the clinical database at start-up. FND-F-006: the application drives Internet Explorer by COM automation for an outbound HTTP request. Both are evidence-supported static findings; runtime behaviour was not observed.

findings.title: Coarse, undocumented authorization model: per-patient grant flags + per-section print passwords
findings.detail: FND-F-007 (Suspected) + UNR-002/003: a per-patient grant model (the 12 grantN columns on the operator table) and per-section numeric print passwords (IDPassword*) form a coarse authorisation scheme. The mapping of grant bits and IDPassword* values to specific sections is unresolved.

findings.title: Bundled third-party components with security/licensing impact are already catalogued
findings.detail: Consolidated register records: U-015 orphaned Avira antivirus kernel-driver descriptors shipped in the deployment; U-019 orphaned unrar 3.50 (20-year-old archive library); U-008 redistributed fonts with prohibitive licence terms (Tahoma renamed); U-033 commercial PDF printer installed in evaluation mode with expired certificate; U-020 unsigned local copies of Windows system DLLs. These are supply-chain observations about the shipped product.

contradictions.subject: VB6 object/form count
contradictions.claim_a: 169 objects (163 forms + 5 modules + 1 class) — B1 findings_register F-02, for V-ROOT-1.00
contradictions.claim_b: 212 objects (132 forms + 66 DataReports + 9 modules + 3 classes) — vb6-objects.json, for v1.605
contradictions.evidence_quality: Both are direct object-table walks, but of different executable builds
contradictions.resolution: Most plausible: a version difference between V1.00 and v1.605 (Class 3, medium confidence). Requires comparing both object tables to confirm. Recorded, not discarded.

contradictions.subject: Embedded SELECT statement count
contradictions.claim_a: 1,337 statements (SELECT 1220, DELETE 72, SHAPE 20, OTHER 25) — statements.csv in this batch
contradictions.claim_b: 1,370 embedded SELECT statements — unified-unresolved-questions UNR-008 text (prior investigation)
contradictions.evidence_quality: Both are static string/statement extractions from the same executable family
contradictions.resolution: Two different extraction passes / corpora. The delta (~33) is not material to any conclusion. Recorded.

limitations: Type 3 does not re-derive target evidence; it inherits prior conclusions (noted where inherited vs independently confirmed).
The master ledger's NOT_YET_RECEIVED state reflects a different workspace snapshot and must not be read as the state of this batch.
Open questions UNR-002/003/004/005 remain genuinely unresolved and are carried into the Unresolved Issues Register.
Some consolidated findings originate from B2, which was explicitly NOT independently re-investigated (UNR-007).
